iterations.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Realm modular game-sprite source board for offline skeletal compilation
Input images: Image 1 is a material-rendering and pixel-cluster style reference only; do not copy its gaff shape or layout.
Primary request: create one coherent four-view orthographic source board of the same small grounded harbor fish creel, shown as front/down view, rear/up view, left view, and right view. The creel is a squat oval handwoven willow basket with a dark wet leather rim and strap hardware, a partly open hinged lid, and two clearly readable freshly caught silver-blue fish resting securely inside. The fish must remain contained by the basket and never appear detached. Every view depicts exactly the same creel, materials, contents, scale, and construction.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #ff00ff chroma-key background for local background removal.
Style/medium: premium hand-painted late-1990s 2D strategy-game sprite source art; crisp deliberate pixel clusters, compact readable silhouette, restrained texture, strong material separation, subtle warm top-left lighting; match Image 1's polished game-art rendering density.
Composition/framing: four isolated orthographic views in one horizontal row with generous equal spacing and transparent-removal padding; each object fully visible and centered in its own quarter; no perspective scene, floor, grid, border, labels, or text.
Color palette: honey-brown and umber willow, dark oxblood leather, muted brass fasteners, silver-blue fish with very restrained cool highlights; do not use #ff00ff in the objects.
Constraints: exact same identity and proportions across all four views; front, rear, left, and right are individually authored; crisp closed silhouettes; no cast shadow, no contact shadow, no reflection, no loose droplets, no stray scales, no extra tools, no humans, no watermark. Background must be one uniform #ff00ff with no shadows, gradients, texture, floor plane, or lighting variation.
Avoid: concept-sheet annotations, duplicate viewpoints, open empty basket, detached fish, realistic photographic rendering, smooth airbrushed edges, oversized object, clipping, merged objects, magenta contamination inside the subject.
iterations.result: rejected because the rear/up view closed the lid and hid the catch
